Embeddings retention is enforceable by tenant policy and we have a purge job. I'll open an EngOps ticket to capture exact steps.

josh_kim: Here you go:

```
Q: Are embeddings or derived vectors stored, and if so, what is the retention period and deletion procedure?
A: Yes — embeddings are stored for up to 30 days by default for hosted customers. Customers can request shorter retention or immediate deletion. Deletion requests trigger an asynchronous purge job and associated audit log entry; data is removed from live storage and KV caches, with final purge completed within 24 hours of the request in typical cases. For customers requiring customer-managed keys, we support KMS integration (GCP/AWS) for hosted and full BYOK/HSM for Dedicated/Private deployments; timelines vary by option.
```
